description: Turn text read from a reagent bottle or kit label (OCR or typed) into structured fields such as product name, catalog number, lot, expiry, concentration and storage. Parses the provided text only; send the label text, not an image.

ocrConfidence.description: Optional OCR confidence percentage from the OCR engine.

ocrText.description: OCR text extracted from a reagent label image. The browser tool performs OCR locally; this endpoint parses provided text only.

sourceImageName.description: Optional source image file name or identifier for review context.

name: parse_reagent_label

card.description: What the Verbex card draws; same values as the notebook entry.

notebookEntry.description: Markdown entry to paste into a lab notebook.

title: Reagent label parser
